story.fullStory:
Blondie's "The Tide Is High" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100. "The Tide Is High" is a 1967 rocksteady song originally written and performed by Jamaican singer John Holt and his group the Paragons for their album On the Beach.

The track was produced by Duke Reid for his Treasure Isle label.

The song gained international attention in 1980, when a cover version by the American band Blondie became a US and UK number one hit.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 26 weeks on the chart.
